verdict.rationale: The ADK GitHub README documents a built-in Tool Confirmation (HITL) flow that guards tool execution with explicit confirmation and custom input. That maps directly to requiring approval before sensitive tool calls run. The workflow runtime and Task API also list human-in-the-loop support, and callbacks offer lifecycle hooks around execution. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how confirmation is configured per specific tool (e.g. selective or policy-based gating), details of the approval UX, independent or hands-on corroboration.
